info.title: Doogie by EZtoFind.ca — BC Real Estate Actions
info.description: Read + write actions for Doogie, the British Columbia real-estate helper GPT operated by Doug LeMaire, REALTOR® of Fraser Property Management Realty Services Ltd. All property data flows from CREA DDF® under a signed technology-provider agreement. Educational retrieval only — never advice.

get.description: Returns active British Columbia listings from CREA DDF®. Filter by city, community, price band, bed/bath count, or property type. Every result includes a direct link back to eztofind.ca/listings/{listing_key} — always surface this link to the user so they can view full details, photos, and virtual tours on Doug's site.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: BC city or community (case-insensitive). Examples: Kitsilano, Vancouver, Burnaby, Kelowna, Whistler, Maple Ridge.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: House · Apartment · Townhouse · Duplex · Acreage · Land. Omit for any type.

eztofind_url.description: Absolute link back to eztofind.ca/listings/{listing_key} — always surface to the user.

get.summary: Get full details for one BC MLS® listing
get.description: Returns full details — description, photos, virtual tour URL (Matterport / YouTube / Vimeo), room dimensions, taxes, strata fees, and days-on-market — for a single listing_key. Always surface the eztofind.ca URL so the user can view the listing with Doug's compliance context.

404.description: Listing not found or no longer active.

get.summary: Aggregate market stats for a BC city or community
get.description: Returns active-inventory count, median + average list price, min/max list price, avg beds/baths for the requested BC city/community, computed live from CREA DDF®. Always disclose that these are LIST-price statistics — never a valuation or forecast.

post.summary: Look up BC real-estate terms, statutes, community pages, and FAQs
post.description: Educational lookup across Doug's 439-entry BC glossary, community profiles, buying/selling journey tools, and CREA DDF® listings. Returns grouped sections (Listings / Terms / Communities / FAQs / Tools). Use this whenever the user asks 'what is …', 'how does …', 'explain …', or names a BC-specific concept (strata, PTT, RESA, subject-free, HBRP, etc.). Always cite the eztofind.ca link the result carries.

200.description: Grouped sections with items — each item carries an eztofind.ca href.

post.summary: Send a buyer consultation request to Doug LeMaire
post.description: Consent-first buyer consultation request. Only call this AFTER the user has explicitly: (a) said they want to buy, (b) confirmed they are NOT under a signed buyer's agency agreement with another REALTOR® (REALTOR® Code of Ethics Article 16), (c) supplied name + email + phone, and (d) given explicit CASL consent to be contacted. Do not fabricate any of these fields. Doug personally reviews every request within 1 business day.

working_with_realtor.description: MUST be false to submit (REALTOR® Code of Ethics).

casl_consent.description: Must be true — user explicitly consented.

pipa_ack.description: Must be true — user acknowledged privacy policy.

200.description: Lead accepted. Reply confirming Doug will reach out in 1 business day.

422.description: Validation failed — walk the user through the missing field.

post.summary: Send a seller Market Estimate request to Doug LeMaire
post.description: Consent-first seller Market Estimate request. Only call this AFTER the user has explicitly: (a) said they want to sell, (b) confirmed the home is NOT currently listed with another REALTOR® (REALTOR® Code of Ethics Article 16), (c) supplied property address + city + name + email + phone, and (d) given explicit CASL + PIPA consent. Doug personally reviews every request within 1 business day.

post.summary: Refer a user outside Doug's service area to a local BC REALTOR®
post.description: Doug is licensed BC-wide but personally represents transactions ONLY in Greater Vancouver, Fraser Valley, and Sea-to-Sky Corridor. When a user is looking in Interior BC, Vancouver Island, Northern BC, Kootenays, or Okanagan, call this to connect them with a vetted local REALTOR® from Doug's network.

target_area.description: BC city or region the user is targeting.
